english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately omitting an item, step, or section.

examples.english: This page is too long, so I decided to skip it.
examples.traditional: 呢一頁太長，我決定跳過佢。

english.note: Use this when the leap carries someone over an obstacle or gap.
